messages.content: 想像一下你正在玩一款角色扮演遊戲，並且想要創建一個新的玩家檔案。你決定將你的角色命名為「屠龍者」，並選擇「戰士」作為你的職業。你也想要從第5級開始。設定完你的檔案後，你想要休息一下，找一場附近的音樂會參加。你目前在「紐約」，想要找一場演奏「搖滾」音樂的音樂會。晚上，你決定用一副標準的52張撲克牌和5張手牌來玩撲克牌。得到一副葫蘆牌的機率是多少？第二天，你決定去遠足，並想要計算兩個地理坐標之間的坡度。第一個坐標是[40.7128，-74.0060]（紐約，紐約州），第二個坐標是[34.0522，-118.2437]（加州洛杉磯）。你想要以「度」為單位計算坡度。你能提供所有這些情況的資訊嗎？

function.name: poker_probability_full_house
function.description: Calculate the probability of getting a full house in a poker game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

deck_size.description: The size of the deck. Default is 52.

hand_size.description: The size of the hand. Default is 5.

function.name: calculate_slope_gradient
function.description: Calculate the slope gradient between two geographical coordinates. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

point1.description: The geographic coordinates for the first point [Latitude, Longitude].

point2.description: The geographic coordinates for the second point [Latitude, Longitude].

unit.description: The unit for the slope gradient. Default is 'degree'.

function.name: concert_find_nearby
function.description: Locate nearby concerts based on specific criteria like genre. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. Seattle, WA

genre.description: Genre of music to be played at the concert.

function.name: create_player_profile
function.description: Create a new player profile with character name, class and starting level. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

player_name.description: The desired name of the player.

class_type.description: The character class for the player. Default ''

starting_level.description: The starting level for the player
